facts.title: ci: remove the summary job; the required checks name the jobs directly
facts.body: Recorded review of a bounded repository change. Original identifying metadata removed.
facts.author: contributor
facts.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -30,22 +30,6 @@ jobs:
     name: ci / checks
     uses: example/shared/.github/workflows/shared-ci.yml@v1
 
-  summary:
-    name: ci / summary
-    needs: [checks, build, lint]
-    if: always()
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    steps:
-      - name: Fail when a needed job did not succeed
-        env:
-          RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
-        run: |
-          set -euo pipefail
-          # A job skipped on a documentation-only PR counts as satisfied.
-          if jq -e 'to_entries[] | select(.value.result == "failure")' <<<"$RESULTS"; then
-            exit 1
-          fi
-
   build:
     name: ci / build
     needs: [checks]
diff --git a/GUIDE.md b/GUIDE.md
index 1234567..7654321 100644
--- a/GUIDE.md
+++ b/GUIDE.md
@@ -37,7 +37,7 @@ Run the checks locally before you push.
 
 ## CI
 
-`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, required through the `summary` job: the shared `checks` job, plus this repo's own `build` and `lint` jobs. Secret scanning is a separate required check.
+`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, with each job's check required directly: the shared `checks` job (`ci / checks`), plus this repo's own `build` (`ci / build`) and `lint` (`ci / lint`). A new job needs its check added to the branch protection settings. Secret scanning is a separate required check.
 
 ## Conventions

safety.name: safety
checked: Secret-scan coverage: the receipt shows the secret-scan check succeeded on head 3456cde, which runs over the PR diff. The only file in the delta is `GUIDE.md`, and a skim of its one changed hunk (line 40) found no key-, token- or credential-shaped content. This would have caught a secret committed in the doc edit.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

works-and-proven.name: works-and-proven
checked: Compared the documented check names in the delta (`GUIDE.md:40`) with the job `name:` values in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` at head 3456cde. The docs list `ci / checks`, `ci / build` and `ci / lint`, and the workflow produces exactly those. This would have caught docs naming a check the workflow no longer reports, such as a leftover mention of `summary` or `ci / summary`.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

principal-engineer.name: principal-engineer
checked: Compared the reviewed head 2345bcd with head 3456cde (only `GUIDE.md` changed) and read `GUIDE.md:40` at the head sha. This would have caught the R1-F1 stale reference to the `summary` job still being there, or a new wrong description of the gate. The line no longer names the summary job. It now describes the gate as each job's check, required directly.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

maintainable-no-slop.name: maintainable-no-slop
checked: Compared the delta between the two heads (`GUIDE.md` only) and read `GUIDE.md:40` at the head sha against `.github/workflows/ci.yml` at the head sha. Each check name the guide gives must match what the workflow reports: `ci / checks`, `ci / build` and `ci / lint`. This would have caught comment drift, where the rewritten guide names a check or job the workflow does not report.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

voice.summary: Reviewed against the summoned lenses; no blocking findings.
